name: SpareBank 1 Nord-Norge
verdict: A Norwegian savings bank owned through its foundation and region; no state or fund owner in the chain.
note: Rating note: Generalpartner of Bodø/Glimt and front-of-shirt sponsor. A sparebank (savings bank) whose equity certificates are held by Sparebankstiftelsen Nord-Norge for long-term regional ownership; no state control or state-fund stake, so 'none'.
